findings: In `components[1].sound_limitation`, include the historical comparison reported in X-02b4a23cf64709debac4: 机 is reconstructed there as Middle Chinese `kijX` and Old Chinese `*krəjʔ`, while 機 is `kj+j` and `*kəj`. Clarify that the 机 forms are local dataset evidence, not independently confirmed upstream, and neither reconstruction establishes the pronunciation of the old tree word. The current limitation mentions only a modern comparison and omits this relevant, qualified historical evidence.
